7908.title: MCP diagnostic payloads omitted from the timeline
7908.rootCauseOneLine: Codex MCP translation omits result bodies while retaining explicit error messages; attribution to the original URL restriction is unverified.
7908.proposedFix: Validate and retain MCP result diagnostics after confirming the original event shape; obtain upstream policy guidance before describing recovery.
7908.caveats: Two clean unit reproductions establish result loss only. The original macOS URL rejection, policy source, and supported recovery are unverified. Complete test and output are inline because the reports repository forbids separate artifacts.
